description:
Footstep audio plugin for Person atoms. Detects when feet contact surfaces and plays surface-appropriate sound samples — boots on wood, bare feet on carpet, heels on tile, etc. 24 built-in surfaces, per-foot AudioSources with 3D spatial positioning, pitch jitter for sample variety, per-foot cooldowns, and EventTrigger panels for wiring custom VaM actions to step events. Drop-in support for custom .wav and .mp3 samples (no naming convention).

Credits: MacGruber (MacGruber_Utils), geesp0t and AcidBubbles (collision/trigger reference). Attribution for the original work is in the bundled LICENSE file.

Load on a Person atom via Plugins tab → Add Plugin.
credits: MacGruber (MacGruber_Utils.cs), geesp0t (spanking plugin reference), AcidBubbles (collision groundwork)
instructions: Add to a Person atom via the Plugins tab → Add Plugin. Pick a sound surface from the 'Sounds' dropdown. Adjust Impact Min/Max and Cooldown to taste.
